name: Capital Cities and Tombs of the Ancient Koguryo Kingdom
description: In northeast China, around Ji'an in Jilin and Huanren in Liaoning, lie the ruins of three fortified cities and 40 tombs from the Koguryo kingdom. The kingdom ruled parts of northern China and the northern Korean Peninsula for centuries. Fourteen of the tombs belong to emperors and 26 to nobles. Some have clever stone ceilings that span wide chambers without columns while supporting a heavy mound above.
